lesson.uz:
Massiv bir xil turdagi qiymatlarni saqlaydi. n ta element indekslari 0 dan n-1 gacha. Declare’da Array ni belgilang va Size=n yozing; n avval kiritilgan bo‘lsin.
Input a[i] orqali qiymatlarni saqlang. Keyin alohida siklda hisoblang yoki teskari tartibda chiqaring. a[n] mavjud emas. Eng katta qiymat uchun boshlang‘ich qiymatni a[0] dan oling, agar n kamida 1 bo‘lsa.
lesson.en:
An array stores values of one type. An array of size n has indexes 0 to n-1. Enable Array in Declare and set Size=n after reading n.
Read values using Input a[i]. Use a separate loop to calculate or output in reverse order. a[n] is outside the array. Initialize a maximum with a[0] when n is at least 1.

text.uz: Shartdagi talab etilgan bloklarga e’tibor bering.
text.en: Check the required blocks in each task.

text.uz: Har bir Input alohida qatorni o‘qiydi. Natijani namuna bilan taqqoslang.
text.en: Each Input reads one line. Compare your output with the examples.

statement.uz: Maktab do‘koni: n ta zaxirani massivga saqlang. So‘ng zaxiralarni teskari tartibda chiqaring. Indekslar 0 dan boshlanadi.
statement.en: School shop: Store n stock values in an array, then print stock values in reverse order. Indexes start at 0.

inputFormat.uz: n (1..100), keyin n ta butun son (0..10000), har biri alohida qatorda.
inputFormat.en: n (1..100), then n integers (0..10000), one per line.

outputFormat.uz: So‘ralgan natijalarni berilgan tartibda, har birini alohida qatorda chiqaring. Qo‘shimcha matn chiqarmang.
outputFormat.en: Print the requested results in order, one per line, with no extra text.

hints.uz: Kirishdagi qiymatlarni yozib oling va bitta namunani qo‘lda hisoblang.
hints.en: Name the input values and work through one example by hand.

hints.uz: Darsdagi blok tartibidan foydalaning. Natija qayerda yangilanishini aniqlang.
hints.en: Use the block order from the lesson. Identify where the result changes.

hints.uz: Eng kichik kirish qiymati va shart chegarasini alohida tekshiring. Keraksiz matn chiqarmang.
